caption: The drawing depicts a wooden statue of a standing female figure with dark brown skin, wearing a red dress adorned with gold trim and a blue-green sash crossing from her left shoulder to her right hip. The figure is positioned with her left foot stepped forward and elevated on a block, while her left arm hangs down at her side holding what appears to be a bundle or block, and her right arm is bent at the elbow with the hand raised and palm facing upward. She wears gold bracelets on both wrists and a gold necklace around her neck. The figure's head is adorned with a headband labeled "CAVARNA" and a large headdress of three tall feathers colored in red and blue-green. The figure stands on a wooden pedestal composed of painted gray rectangular blocks, with the front left block featuring a reddish-brown inset rectangle. The background is a plain, cream-colored surface.
title: Cigar Store Indian
